## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION: Conflicting signals with weak breadth and narrow leadership. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in Top 5); multiple large-cap divergences support a cautious stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Technology leads: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Energy pockets via SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND. Financials show selective strength: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Consumer Discretionary lagging with TSLA in CORRECTION (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) and RCL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%). Healthcare weak with LLY in CORRECTION (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) and JNJ in CORRECTION (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%). Industrials soft: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -1.10%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -6.34% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, XOM (1W: -5.09% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in select financial and semiconductor names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strong 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged — several large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatches (TSLA, XOM, LLY, AMAT), so treat momentum as tactical, not broad-based.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech is driving performance but leadership is concentrated and breadth is narrow (Tech part of the 4/11 positive sectors). CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND — mixed internals warrant selectivity.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are modestly positive and selective: JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +4.38%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND while PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND signals dispersion. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare under pressure this week with several names showing short-term weakness or exhaustion; UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY, JNJ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION — defensive bid absent and rotation risk remains.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to proven ABOVE TREND large-caps (CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to names showing CORRECTION or BELOW TREND (PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND). Monitor narrow leadership and major divergences before adding cyclical beta.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Technology (clustered leadership, part of 4/11 positives) and select Energy (SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare where internals are deteriorating (TSLA CORRECTION; LLY CORRECTION).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch follow-through in CRM and NOW to validate the large 1W gains; failure to hold recent intraday pivots would signal rapid mean-reversion. Monitor PYPL breach of recent support to confirm extended weakness and AMAT continuation below its 1M lows as a semiconductor risk trigger.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
CRM (+60): CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by strong price action after a bullish CEO/earnings narrative. BA (+60): BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND — bullish defense order headline diverges from price (distribution risk).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-80): META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND — very bearish news but price is rising, a clear divergence to monitor. PYPL (-50): PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — bearish sentiment confirmed by sharp price weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership amid narrow tech concentration and weak breadth (4/11). CRM, MSFT and SLB showing relative strength (CRM ABOVE TREND, MSFT ABOVE TREND, SLB ABOVE TREND). Key risk: major divergence between headlines and price (META negative news but ABOVE TREND; PYPL negative news and BELOW TREND) — monitor for trend breaks.
